user.title: Add a station
user.description: Search an Italian station. Each station creates arrivals, departures and a last successful refresh sensor. Data uses ViaggiaTreno's public HTTP API.

reconfigure.title: Replace this station
reconfigure.description: Select a different station for this entry. Existing entity IDs are preserved, so cards and automations will now refer to the new station. To keep both stations, add another integration entry instead.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to obtain valid data from ViaggiaTreno. Please try again later.
error.no_stations: No matching stations found. Try a different name.

abort.invalid_station: The selected station is invalid. Start again.

init.title: Polling options
init.description: Both boards refresh together. Minimum 30 seconds; default 60 seconds. Changing this reloads only this station, not Home Assistant.
